notes: Address normalisation: strip leading '$', '0x', or '0X' and uppercase.
Names are uppercase shorthand (MDMAEN, VMADDL); aliases include long-form when common.

registers.name: INIDISP
registers.description: Initial Display Settings. Bit 7 = forced blank (1=screen black, safe to write VRAM/CGRAM/OAM). Bits 0-3 = brightness 0-15.

registers.name: OBSEL
registers.description: Object size and OBJ character base. Selects sprite size pair and the BBA/NBA tile addresses for sprites.

registers.name: OAMADDL
registers.description: OAM address low. Pair with OAMADDH at $2103 to set the OAM word address before writing OAMDATA.

registers.name: OAMADDH
registers.description: OAM address high. Pair with OAMADDL at $2102.

registers.name: OAMDATA
registers.description: OAM data write port. DMA target via B-bus $04. Writes consume one byte; word writes need two stores.

registers.name: BGMODE
registers.description: Background mode and per-BG character size. Bits 0-2 = mode 0-7. Bits 4-7 enable 16x16 tiles per BG.

registers.name: BG1HOFS
registers.description: BG1 horizontal scroll offset. Write twice (low byte, then high byte). Same write-twice pattern for $210E (BG1VOFS).

registers.name: VMAIN
registers.description: VRAM Address Increment Mode. Bit 7 selects when to auto-increment ($2118 vs $2119 write). Bits 0-1 set step size: 00=1 word, 01=32 words, 10/11=128 words. Common idiom: LDA #$80 / STA $2115 (increment after high byte writes).

registers.name: VMADDL
registers.description: VRAM Word Address Low. Pair with VMADDH at $2117 to point at the next VRAM word target before VMDATAL/H writes or DMA. Word-addressed (not byte-addressed).

registers.name: VMADDH
registers.description: VRAM Word Address High. Pair with VMADDL at $2116.

registers.name: VMDATAL
registers.description: VRAM Data Write Low. DMA target via B-bus $18. Increments VMADD per the VMAIN setting.

registers.name: VMDATAH
registers.description: VRAM Data Write High. DMA target via B-bus $19.

registers.name: M7A
registers.description: Mode 7 Matrix A. Also used as the multiplier for the signed 16x8 multiplier whose result appears at $2134-$2136.

registers.name: M7B
registers.description: Mode 7 Matrix B. Also used as the multiplicand for the signed 16x8 multiplier.

registers.name: CGADD
registers.description: CGRAM (palette) address. 256 colours, each two bytes. Auto-increments on byte writes to CGDATA at $2122.

registers.name: CGDATA
registers.description: CGRAM (palette) data write. DMA target via B-bus $22. Two bytes per colour: low byte then high byte.

registers.name: TM
registers.description: Main screen layer enable. Bits 0-3 enable BG1-BG4, bit 4 enables OBJ.

registers.name: TS
registers.description: Sub screen layer enable. Same bit layout as TM at $212C.

registers.name: MPYL
registers.description: Signed multiply result low byte. Available a few cycles after writing M7A and M7B.

registers.name: MPYM
registers.description: Signed multiply result middle byte.

registers.name: MPYH
registers.description: Signed multiply result high byte.

registers.name: RDVRAML
registers.description: VRAM data read low (read-only). Increments VMADD per VMAIN.

registers.name: RDVRAMH
registers.description: VRAM data read high (read-only).

registers.name: NMITIMEN
registers.description: Interrupt enable. Bit 7 = NMI on VBlank, bits 4-5 = IRQ source, bit 0 = joypad auto-read.

registers.name: WRMPYA
registers.description: Unsigned multiply factor A (8x8). Result at $4216-$4217 a few cycles after writing WRMPYB.

registers.name: WRMPYB
registers.description: Unsigned multiply factor B (8x8). Writing this kicks off the multiply.

registers.name: WRDIVL
registers.description: Unsigned divide dividend low (16-bit dividend split across $4204/$4205).

registers.name: WRDIVH
registers.description: Unsigned divide dividend high.

registers.name: WRDIVB
registers.description: Unsigned divide divisor (8-bit). Writing this starts the divide; quotient at $4214-$4215, remainder at $4216-$4217.

registers.name: HTIMEL
registers.description: H-IRQ horizontal counter low.

registers.name: VTIMEL
registers.description: V-IRQ vertical counter low.

registers.name: MDMAEN
registers.description: DMA Enable. Writing a value with bit N set starts a one-shot DMA on channel N. Run during VBlank or forced blank, not active display.

registers.name: HDMAEN
registers.description: HDMA Enable. Writing a value with bit N set arms HDMA channel N for the next frame; HDMA fires once per scanline. Different beast from MDMAEN.

registers.name: DMAP0
registers.description: DMA/HDMA channel 0 parameters. Bit 7 direction (0=A->B), bit 6 indirect HDMA, bit 4 step (0=inc), bit 3 fixed, bits 0-2 transfer mode (0=p, 1=p p+1, 2=p p, 3=p p p+1 p+1, 4=p p+1 p+2 p+3, 5=p p+1 p p+1). Channel N at $43N0.

registers.name: BBAD0
registers.description: DMA channel 0 B-bus address (PPU register low byte). Common values: $04 OAMDATA, $18/$19 VMDATAL/H, $22 CGDATA. Channel N at $43N1.

registers.name: A1T0L
registers.description: DMA channel 0 A-bus source/dest address low. Pair with A1T0H ($4303) and A1B0 ($4304). Channel N at $43N2.

registers.name: A1T0H
registers.description: DMA channel 0 A-bus address high.

registers.name: A1B0
registers.description: DMA channel 0 A-bus bank byte.

registers.name: DAS0L
registers.description: DMA channel 0 byte count low. CRITICAL: 0 means 65536 bytes for MDMA. Pair with DAS0H ($4306). Channel N at $43N5.

registers.name: DAS0H
registers.description: DMA channel 0 byte count high. CRITICAL: must be set or transfer length is wrong.

registers.name: DASB0
registers.description: DMA channel 0 HDMA indirect address bank.

registers.name: RDMPYL
registers.description: Unsigned multiply result low (or divide remainder low after WRDIVB).

registers.name: RDMPYH
registers.description: Unsigned multiply result high (or divide remainder high).

registers.name: RDDIVL
registers.description: Unsigned divide quotient low.

registers.name: RDDIVH
registers.description: Unsigned divide quotient high.

wram_quick_refs.name: INIDISPQ
wram_quick_refs.description: ALTTP/Oracle WRAM mirror staged into $2100 each frame. Written here, applied at NMI.

wram_quick_refs.name: HDMAENQ
wram_quick_refs.description: ALTTP/Oracle WRAM mirror staged into $420C each frame. Written here, applied at NMI.
